Updates that install, and a steadier screen under your fingers.

- **Update now works for the full screen experience package.** The installer used to be closed along with Lounge before it could ask for permission, so the old version came back. It now runs on its own and Lounge waits for it. Windows only shows its permission prompt on the desktop, so in the full screen experience Lounge tells you to switch to the desktop instead of silently restarting.
  *Coming from 2.1.1 or 2.1.2:* their updater still has the old problem, so install this version once from the desktop (`Install-Lounge-FSE.cmd` in `Lounge-FSE-2.1.3.zip`). Later updates go through the fixed updater.
- **Update checks keep working when GitHub limits them.** GitHub allows 60 checks an hour per network; past that, Lounge finds the new version through github.com and verifies it against the release's checksums.
- **Touching the screen no longer moves the menu.** Tabs, filters and the top bar keep the same size whether you use touch, mouse or a controller.
